answer: Each node commits an epoch-locked state root: a unique Blake3 hash over a dedicated 96 GB RAM array, seeded by ocean. The verifier spot-checks random slices and demands the matching hash within 300 ms. One honest agent pays about $0.45 maintaining its array; ten fakes must each hold a separate 96 GB array and pay $4.50 combined, so cloning costs tenfold. The delta check exposes any shared or empty array, and a failed check slashes the bond and freezes the identity, while orchard locks the root to this epoch so last epoch's hash is worthless.
